title: How to keep enjoying programming in a world of LLMs
summary: A thoughtful community discussion on the Haskell forum exploring how programmers can maintain passion and purpose in their craft as LLM-powered coding tools become increasingly capable. The conversation addresses existential concerns about the future of human programmers and offers perspectives on finding meaning beyond code generation.
problem_solved: Addresses the psychological challenge of staying motivated and finding fulfillment as an LLM-assisted development world emerges
why_valuable: Provides valuable mental frameworks and community wisdom for developers grappling with AI's impact on their profession and craft
